## To be completed before the semester

Several items the sessions rely on are **not** in this list and need adding:
the AS2303 motor (the list still shows the older AT2303), the B-G431B-ESC1, the
AS5047P sensor, the ST-Link programmer, the FAAV PCB v3.0 and its BOM, the XIAO
ESP32S3, 4 mm steel rod for the motor shaft, 5 mm PEEK stock, foam, membrane
material, silicone sealant and CorrosionX.

Suppliers are also mostly Swiss, inherited from the EPFL origin of the project.
They will need US equivalents for MIT procurement.
:::
